purpose: Teach: くっつけ/談笑/オット/奥底/仇/ぶさ/里帰り/見いだす

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、シールをノートにくっつけ過ぎないようにね
lines.en: Sho, don't stick too many stickers on your notebook, okay?
lines.style: Gentle, practical reminder. Soft but clear authority. Not a scolding — just a mother's everyday guidance, said while she's doing something else. Warm undertone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんとご友人が談笑されてたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and his friend were having such a nice conversation.
lines.style: Quiet observation, slightly proud. Small voice that's noticing something good happening. No urgency — just sharing a moment he wanted her to know about. Genuine pleasure.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お母さんはオットがいるから安心ね
lines.en: Sho, I feel at ease because your father is here.
lines.style: Warm, reflective. Not defensive — just stating something true to herself as much as to him. A soft exhale of contentment. Tender but steady.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんへの感謝を心の奥底に持ってるよ
lines.en: Mom, I keep gratitude for Dad deep in my heart.
lines.style: Earnest, carefully chosen words. A six-year-old speaking beyond his years — not precocious but genuine. Quiet conviction. Slight pause before 'deep', like he's finding the right words.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、人を仇のように見てはダメよ
lines.en: Sho, don't look at people like they're your enemies.
lines.style: Gentle correction, not sharp. A mother sensing something and intervening with kindness. Clear and direct, but with warmth underneath. Not lecturing — just steering.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんが「ぶさ顔」じゃなくて格好いいって思うよ
lines.en: Mom, I don't think Dad's ugly — I think he's cool.
lines.style: Small wry smile in the voice. Child defending someone he loves with offhand certainty. Not defensive about it — just matter-of-fact. A little pleased with himself for the argument.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お盆はお父さんと里帰りしましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's go back home with your father during Obon, alright?
lines.style: Warm, inclusive phrasing. A mother planning something that matters. Gentle anticipation in the voice — she's including him in the decision, not deciding for him. Tender.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんの中にぼくの夢を見いだすよ
lines.en: Mom, I see my own dreams when I look at Dad.
lines.style: Serious, quiet, sincere. A child reaching for something profound. Not performative — he means every word. Slow, deliberate. A moment of real connection he's offering his mother.
